worldcombat.skill.trickroom.summary: Pressed into a chosen patch of ground, a twisted space that inverts movement speed for everyone inside: slower than the reference is pushed faster, faster is dragged slower. Both sides are treated alike, and stepping out restores you at once.
worldcombat.skill.trickroom.use.0: Let slow allies take the first step
worldcombat.skill.trickroom.use.1: Drag down a fast foe's charge
worldcombat.skill.trickroom.use.2: Twist the ground between you and the foe
Raises a space of radius %2$s blocks on the chosen ground, lasting %1$s.

The space treats %1$s as the reference speed: a body inside has its movement speed multiplied by (reference divided by its own movement speed) squared - slower than the reference is pushed faster, faster is dragged slower. The multiplier bottoms out at %2$s and tops out at its reciprocal; stepping out restores it at once.

The space treats every living body inside its radius with a clear line to the centre alike, allies and enemies; staying inside keeps it twisted and stepping out restores it at once. It ends early if the caster falls or moves more than about 48 blocks from the centre, and otherwise vanishes when its time runs out.
Pressing the space out takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. See the twist note for the strong/gentle trade-off.
worldcombat.skill.trickroom.turn.0: Strong: lowest multiplier x0.7 (a harder twist), at duration x0.8 and cooldown x1.15 — short and violent.
worldcombat.skill.trickroom.turn.1: Gentle: lowest multiplier x1.35 (milder), in exchange for duration x1.2 and cooldown x0.85 — held long and refreshed often.
worldcombat.skill.trickroom.timing: Cast at ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to press the space out, recovers %3$s, and commits a %5$s cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.trickroom.preference.t: Strong: lowest multiplier x0.7 (a harder twist), duration x0.8, cooldown x1.15 — good for a short, violent tempo swing. Gentle: lowest multiplier x1.35 (milder), duration x1.2, cooldown x0.85 — good to hold a patch of ground for a long time.
worldcombat.skill.trickroom.preference.a: The companion only considers the trick room while a threat is within this distance; lower presses it up close, higher sets it up in advance.
Push the space at the foe
On, the space is pushed forward to the fighting line to drag the foe down; off, the feet spot and the fighting line are compared by real payoff and the better one is used.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to press the space.
